meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth - startup tips, working tips, and any Tip: line shown in the TUI (including the Fable-5-refusal fallback tip). Use when the user asks about a Tip: line, says give-me-tips, asks what a tip means, how a tipped feature works, or which tips they can see. Queries the live tip list (senpi --list-tips) first, checks what THIS user can actually see, then verifies the real feature code before explaining.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 深入解释任何senpi提示的含义与用法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用senpi时想弄懂每条提示在说什么
copy.tagline_en: Explain any senpi tip in depth
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand what each senpi tip means and how to use it

howto.what: 装上后，如果你问起senpi里的某条提示（Tip: 行），Claude会先查询你实际能看到的提示列表，再核对相关功能代码，然后用你的语言详细解释这条提示背后的真实机制，并引用代码文件路径。
howto.when: 当你说出“give-me-tips”、问“Tip:行”是什么意思，或询问某条提示的功能/你能看到哪些提示时触发。

say.text: 刚才看到的“Tip:”行是什么意思？
say.note: Claude会先查你的tip列表再解释。

say.text: 给我解释一下现在这条提示背后的实现。
say.note: 它会核对代码并引用路径。

say.text: 用中文详细说说Fable 5拒绝后那条tip的原理。
say.note: 会解释完整的fallback架构流程。

howto.what_en: When installed, if the user asks about any Tip: line in senpi, Claude first queries the live tip list, checks which tips this user can actually see, verifies the relevant feature code, then explains the underlying mechanism in the user's language, citing file paths.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions a Tip: line, says 'give-me-tips', or asks what a tip means / whether they can see a tip.

say_en.note: It queries your tip list first.

say_en.text: Explain the implementation behind this tip.
say_en.note: It verifies code and cites paths.

say_en.text: In Chinese, detail the Fable-5 refusal tip.
